text:
The sacred image has
a blue thorn.
Jesus is baptized
in orange. Almost beyond
again and again the Last Judgment.
Blessed ones who smile and
form choirs. Pale green
the earth sinks, but
the heavens soon grow calm.
Brighter, they wave like silver
flags in slow motion,
and the tallest candle strives
and gives off scent.
I stand before you in cold dust
I stand before you from somewhere
from a frozen darkness
I stand before you and sing praise:
gazes of praise lifted me
from the weary stirrups of my
feeling, without a murmur.
